<div class="card-body">
'''TIE Advanced x1''' is a [[Dark]] [[Starship]] from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">タイ・アドヴァンストｘ１（先行試作機）</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">能力値１の専属パイロットが搭乗している。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-303o-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">タイ・アドバンストｘ１は動力、装甲、火力の全てが強化されており、帝国宇宙軍のエリート・パイロットに支給される。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' TIE Advanced x1 (prototype).

'''Card text:''' Has a permanent pilot with ability 1.

'''Lore:''' The TIE Advanced x1 has upgraded propulsion, armor, and firepower. It is issued to elite Imperial Navy pilots.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[TIE Advanced x1]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 97. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
